prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2D side-scroller enemy sprite pose sheet. Create a NEW original cute small enemy for Tape City, a bright storybook town of golden adhesive tape loops, cream stone workshops and turquoise roofs. Subject: a cheeky golden-yellow tape-roll beetle creature. Its main body is a chunky round roll of masking tape seen in RIGHT-FACING three-quarter side view; clearly visible cream paper inner ring and dark hollow spool opening on the side, caramel tape layer edges, tiny smiling face and rosy cheek on the front rim, two little mint green mitten hands and two short mint boots below, a small curled tape-end crest on top. A short loose tape tail curls back, contained close to its body. Rounded inviting silhouette, mischievous enemy rather than scary, no weapon. Hand-painted storybook cartoon with gouache texture, warm honey outlines and soft upper-left light. Golden honey, cream and mint accents. EXACTLY SIX isolated full-body poses of the SAME identical character in a strict uniform 3-column x 2-row grid, same body scale, each entirely inside its equal cell with generous transparent gutters. Reading order: 1 idle standing smiling; 2 idle blinking, otherwise body stable; 3 walking stride A with one boot forward and small tape tail bouncing; 4 walking stride B with the other boot forward; 5 defeated dizzy sitting with spiral eyes, both hands out; 6 defeated lower seated/squashed pose, tape body still intact and recognizable, cute and unharmed. Maintain RIGHT facing orientation, same feet baseline for standing poses, whole boots and tape crest inside every cell. Actual transparent background; clean cutout, no background or floor, no outer glow, no gradient, no shadow outside silhouette, no labels or text, no checkerboard, no grid lines. Practical animation art rather than a poster.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2D side-scroller enemy sprite pose sheet. Create a NEW original small mischievous parcel-box creature for Tape City, a cheerful hand-painted fantasy town made of golden adhesive tape loops, cream stone workshops and turquoise roofs. Subject: a cute squat cream-kraft cardboard parcel box monster, clearly BOX SHAPED with softly rounded square edges, honey-gold adhesive tape cross on its body, one peeling golden tape flap as a tiny forelock, expressive large dark plum eyes and a cheeky little toothy smile on the FRONT facing RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Short lavender mitten arms and stubby lavender worker boots; little turquoise corner patches, rosy cheeks, subtle cardboard fibers. A simple unmistakable parcel silhouette, distinct from a round tape roll; no weapons and no handheld objects. Warm storybook cartoon / gouache painting, crisp dark amber outlines, gentle upper-left lighting, cream and honey-gold with lavender and turquoise accents. EXACTLY SIX isolated full-body poses of the SAME identical character in a strict evenly spaced 3-column x 2-row grid with large transparent gutters, every complete character inside its own equal cell, same body scale and consistent standing feet baseline. Reading order: 1 idle standing alert with small grin; 2 idle blinking with body stable; 3 walking stride A, one boot lifted and short arms swinging; 4 walking stride B, opposite boot lifted; 5 defeated dizzy seated pose with spiral eyes, box tipping slightly, flaps loosened; 6 defeated lower sitting pose with folded boots and lid flaps open a little, cute and unharmed, same box identity. All poses face RIGHT, full boots and all cardboard flaps visible and safely inside each cell. Genuinely transparent background, crisp clean alpha cutout, no scene, no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient or glow around character, no checkerboard, no labels, no lettering, no icons, no grid borders, no additional items. Production game art, not a poster.
